meta.name: Treasure Island
meta.description:
Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: The Admiral Benbow
videos.overview: Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess are pulled into a dangerous world when a sailor washes ashore with a pirate’s treasure map. Deciding to seek the treasure for themselves they set sail on the Hispaniola, unaware of the danger on board.

videos.title: Great Britain
videos.overview: Onboard the Hispaniola, Bess targets Graham for protection as Long John lays the groundwork for mutiny with the crew. When violence erupts, Jim makes a calculated move that shifts the balance, tipping the scales in Long John's favor.

videos.title: The Wide Eternal Sea
videos.overview: Alliances fracture as the voyage wears on; Bess and Graham play a cat-and-mouse game, while Long John targets Jim; when Graham makes his move, the truth surfaces; the consequences are deadly and Jim is forced to take control of his fate.

videos.title: San Domingue
videos.overview: Jim saves Long John's life, knowing he still needs him; Graham draws Jim into the world of San Domingue, witnessing power, politics and revolution up close; chaos erupts and Long John gains control of the ship - but Jim has an ace up his sleeve.

videos.title: Skeleton Island
videos.overview: On Skeleton Island, Jim leads the search for the treasure as tension and paranoia rise when the island's dark history emerges; jockeying for control they finally reach the fortune - but an unexpected force intervenes before anyone can claim it.

videos.title: A Princesa De Aveiro
videos.overview: Captive on Skeleton Island, Jim turns the tables in an attempt to catch up to Long John before he can leave with the treasure; back at sea, alliances fracture and reunite, binding the survivors together in a dangerous new partnership.
